title: 5.11 Unit 5 Review
unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
goal: Retrieve food, quantities, meals, positive and negative agreement, wants/needs and complete market/café purchases.
grammar_function: Spiral review of there is/there are, How many ... are there?, some, like and do not like, Me too, want and need, meals with for, prices with dollars, and Can I have ..., please?
speaking_outcome: Say what you like, what you want and need, what you eat for each meal, ask a price and order politely.
